description: Vite app code that ships provider keys to the browser: an OpenAI client built with dangerouslyAllowBrowser and a VITE_ key, a Supabase admin client reading VITE_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, a raw Anthropic fetch with the direct-browser-access header and a VITE_ x-api-key, and a free-tier rotation array of numbered VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY_1..3 keys. VC217 must fire once in each file (the rotation array is one finding that names all three keys); VITE_OPENAI_MODEL in the same file is a public identifier and is not a second finding.
